description: Find census tracts where veterans face the highest housing costs, for housing-aid planning and HUD-VASH/SSVF outreach. Joins ACS rent-burden data with veteran counts. Returns tracts ranked by share of renter households paying 30%+ (or 50%+) of income on rent, with FIPS location codes, veteran density, and existing-resource counts. Useful for grant proposals that cite tract-level rent burden.

measure.description: burden = 30%+ of income on rent; severe = 50%+ (HUD definitions)

min_veterans.description: Minimum veteran count to include tract

state.description: 2-letter state code to filter (e.g. TX, CA)

name: find_high_housing_burden_tracts
title: Find high rent-burden tracts
